description:
List channels visible to the bot in a Discord server.

Args:
  - guild_id (string): Discord server/guild ID
  - type ('text' | 'voice' | 'category' | 'all'): Filter by channel type (default: 'all')
  - response_format ('markdown' | 'json'): Output format (default: 'json')

Returns:
  List of channels with id, name, type, topic, and category info

response_format.description: Output format: 'markdown' for human-readable or 'json' for structured data

name: discord_list_channels
title: List Discord Channels
